title: A goal research worker searches the kb for older answer and fact lines its new facts contradict, and fixes or files each before it lands
goal: The kb-research skill's step 3 tells a goal research worker to run rag.py search on each new fact's claim and fix or file every kb line, ledgers included, that the new fact contradicts before the work commit (SP-23m5etrf: ST-gyr324rf added Cargo feature unification facts to agents/onnx-runtime-rust-ort.md:94 and left the older QK-ort conclusion in _answers.md:2908 that default-features = false removes any accelerator code path, which the review found as an S1 and cost the bug BG-rogddb5j); agents/worker.md tells a worker that fixes a wrong or mis-tagged claim to run rag.py search for its key words across the root and its ledgers and to fix in the item or file beside it each other line that states the same claim before its work commit (SP-ilqhjn3k: BG-lcp6dhpz fixed the 0.10 re-pricing in _conflicts.md while claude/ci-and-headless.md:104 kept it, one more worker cycle)

run: import sys;t=open('.claude/skills/kb-research/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read().split('## 3. Research',1)[1].split('## 4. Write',1)[0];ok=any('contradict' in l and 'rag.py search' in l for l in t.splitlines());print('research step 3 sweeps contradicted lines:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import sys;t=open('agents/worker.md',encoding='utf-8').read();ok=any('rag.py search' in l and 'same claim' in l for l in t.splitlines());print('worker role file sweeps lines of the same claim:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
